question: According to Agricultural Statistics – A Glance 2015, India was the largest producer of which crop in 2013, contributing about 25 per cent of global production?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pulses**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to **Agricultural Statistics – A Glance 2015**, India was the **largest producer of pulses** in 2013.
 
• India contributed about **25 per cent** of the **global production** of pulses in 2013.
 
• Pulses are an essential part of the **Indian diet**, providing a major source of **protein** for the population.
 
• The major pulses produced in India include **chickpeas** (gram), **pigeon peas** (tur), **black grams** (urad), and **green grams** (moong).
 
• India's diverse agro-climatic conditions support the cultivation of a wide variety of pulses throughout the country.
 
• Pulses are also significant in crop rotation practices as they help in **nitrogen fixation**, improving soil fertility.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Millets**__

 __
 
• Millets are a group of highly **variable small-seeded grasses**, widely grown around the world as cereal crops or grains for fodder and human food.
 
• Examples of millets include **pearl millet** (bajra), **finger millet** (ragi), and **foxtail millet** (kangni).
 
• Millets are known for their **drought-resistant properties** and are suitable for cultivation in arid and semi-arid regions.
 
 
 
• **Oilseeds**__
 __
 
• Oilseeds are seeds grown primarily for the extraction of **oils** used in cooking, industrial applications, and other purposes.
 
• Common oilseeds include **soybean, sunflower, rapeseed, and groundnut (peanut)**.
 
• India is one of the major producers of oilseeds globally, with significant cultivation in states like **Gujarat, Madhya Pradesh, and Rajasthan**.
 
 
 
• **Sugarcane**__
 
 
• Sugarcane is a **tropical grass** species used for the production of sugar, ethanol, and other by-products.
 
• India is one of the largest producers of sugarcane in the world, with major cultivation in states like **Uttar Pradesh, Maharashtra, and Tamil Nadu**.
 
• Sugarcane contributes significantly to the **agricultural economy** and the production of **sugar and jaggery** in India.
